t: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–327, $50,000,000 are rescinded.

fable.w: This provision only rescinds previously appropriated funds. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
fable.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–327, $50,000,000 are rescinded.

opus.w: The section only rescinds $50,000,000 of previously appropriated funds. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue, so it brings no one from outside the federal government into a decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section simply rescinds a specific amount of appropriated funds. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government (such as states, tribes, the public, or private entities). It is a unilateral budgetary action by Congress.
qwen_chat.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–327, $50,000,000 are rescinded.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that rescinding funds is a "decision" and therefore any process leading to it involves participation. However, the text itself contains no mention of any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It is a unilateral legislative action regarding budget numbers.
